name: extension-additional-contents-entries
description: The additional-contents-entries extension producing a List of Figures and a List of Tables as their own pages after the main contents. Proves the extension's effect matches the canonical toolchain — Principle XV names an extension without passing comparison coverage as not done. Three chapters mean the entries cite different pages from one another, so a regression printing one page number for every entry fails. Each chapter also carries an UNCAPTIONED figure that must not appear in either list, pinning the rule that a block with no title is skipped rather than given a generated label. The page numbers are the thing most likely to regress: they come from a map filled in as blocks convert, because the converter sets pdf-page-start on sections and not on image or table blocks.
